name: Hanceville Drug Co
summary: A locally owned, third generation family pharmacy on Commercial Street, open since 1916. Request refills online, pick up what you need and stay for a sundae at the soda fountain.

name: Coffee Hour Co.
summary: Fresh roasted coffee from a local roastery, sold in bags from 12 ounces up to 5 pounds. It makes a nice gift for the coffee lover in your life.

name: Sublime Vintage
summary: A vintage clothing shop on Main Street. Thrifters will want to stop in, because you never know what you'll find.

name: Hagar Guitars
summary: Custom electric and bass guitars made right here in Hanceville, plus repairs and upgrades for the guitar you already own.

name: Burns Florist
summary: A locally owned florist for custom bouquets and arrangements, with same day delivery.
hours: Monday to Friday 8 AM to 5 PM; Saturday 8 AM to 2 PM; closed Sunday

name: Mud Creek Arts and Crafts Festival
summary: Once a year, downtown fills up with handmade woodwork, jewelry, seasonal decor and more. This year's festival is Saturday, Nov. 7.

name: Hanceville Holly Market
summary: The city's holiday market has 32 indoor booths with handmade goods, gifts and boutiques. It runs three Saturdays in December, so you can shop local for Christmas.
